# Read Primitives optimizer_exists_to_semijoin

```{tags} reference, query-template, read_primitives
```

> [Read Primitives](../../read-primitives.md) benchmark · [all Read Primitives queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
/* Test EXISTS subquery decorrelation to semijoin optimization */ /* Good optimizers should convert the EXISTS to a semijoin for better performance */
SELECT
  c_custkey,
  c_name,
  c_mktsegment,
  c_nationkey
FROM customer AS c
WHERE
  EXISTS(
    SELECT
      1
    FROM orders AS o
    WHERE
      o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
      AND o.o_orderdate >= CAST('1995-01-01' AS DATE)
      AND o.o_orderdate < CAST('1996-01-01' AS DATE)
      AND o.o_totalprice > 100000
  )
ORDER BY
  c_custkey
LIMIT 1000
```
